lines.en: label rindorm20:
: Rin? Are you in there?
lines.zh: : Rin？你在里面吗？

lines.en: No answer, as expected.
lines.zh: 没有回应，正如所料。

lines.en: I can't blame her for not wanting to be seen when our last run-in ended with her essentially being kicked out of work-
lines.zh: 我不能怪她不想见人——毕竟我们上一次碰面，基本上是以她被赶出工作场所收场的——

lines.en: But that doesn't mean I can't worry either.
lines.zh: 但那也不代表我不能担心。

lines.en: I have a heart.
lines.zh: 我有一颗心。

lines.en: It may be shriveled and bruised and all sorts of worthless, but it still pumps blood. Blood that, as we speak, is draining from my face as the room around me goes cold.
lines.zh: 它也许干瘪、淤青、废物得不成样子，但它依然在泵血。而就在我说话的这会儿，那些血正从我的脸上流干，因为我周围的房间正在变冷。

lines.en: Or at least gets a little colder.
lines.zh: 或者至少，冷了一点。

lines.en: I knock again to no avail and, for a brief moment, feel as if my fist phases through the door.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次，依旧无用，而在短短一瞬里，我感觉自己的拳头穿过了那扇门。

lines.en: Or perhaps that's just what I want it to do.
lines.zh: 又或许，那只是我希望它这么做。

lines.en: It would save me the effort of having to barge in a second time under premature pretenses- something that Rin wasn't exactly very happy about last time.
lines.zh: 那样就能省得我再以不成熟的借口闯一次——上次 Rin 对此可不太高兴。

lines.en: In all fairness, though...right now, she doesn't seem happy about much of anything.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话……眼下她看起来对什么事情都不太高兴。

lines.en: : This is your last chance to answer the door, Rin.
lines.zh: : 这是你最后一次机会来开门了，Rin。

lines.en: : I'm going to come in if you don't open up for me.
lines.zh: : 你要是不给我开，我就要进去了。

lines.en: I jiggle the handle to make sure the door is unlocked and, thankfully, it is.
lines.zh: 我晃了晃门把手，确认门没锁，谢天谢地，确实没锁。

lines.en: I worry that I might be disturbing her after her long bout with sleep deprivation finally came to an end, but I decide that it's more important right now to make sure she's breathing.
lines.zh: 我担心自己会打扰到她——她那段漫长的睡眠不足好不容易才结束——但我决定，眼下更重要的是确认她还有呼吸。

lines.en: It's a morbid thought, but one I force myself to have as it will lessen the impact if she actually isn't.
lines.zh: 这是个阴郁的念头，但我强迫自己去想，因为万一她真的没呼吸了，它能减轻冲击。

lines.en: scene black
I knock one last time.
lines.zh: 我最后敲了一次。

lines.en: I pause.
lines.zh: 我停顿了一下。

lines.en: scene black
I turn the handle.
lines.zh: 我转动把手。

lines.en: scene rinisfine1
Rin sits alone on her bed without acknowledging my existence.
lines.zh: Rin 独自坐在床上，没有理会我的存在。

lines.en: The faint glow of her computer screen illuminates her pale skin as-
lines.zh: 电脑屏幕微弱的光照亮她苍白的皮肤，而——
: Rin？……

lines.en: As blood oozes from between her fingers and drips onto her leg.
lines.zh: 血从她的指缝间渗出来，滴到她的腿上。

lines.en: I feel an obvious compulsion to approach her, but...what would I even do if I could get her to respond?
lines.zh: 我有一种明显的冲动想靠近她，可是……就算我能让她回应，我又能做什么呢？

lines.en: What is the proper way to handle something like this? And how can I be so aware yet so lost at the same time?
lines.zh: 处理这种事的正确方式是什么？我怎么能一边如此清醒，一边又如此迷失？

lines.en: : Haruka...is worried about you, you know.
lines.zh: : Haruka……很担心你，你知道吗。

lines.en: Again, nothing.
lines.zh: 依旧，什么都没有。

lines.en: I grasp at the longest straw I can think of, hoping that it will be strong enough for me to pull the two of us to shore before we drown in this darkness.
lines.zh: 我抓住我能想到的最长的一根稻草，希望它足够结实，能在我俩溺死在这片黑暗里之前把我们一起拽上岸。

lines.en: : I saw Chika on the way over here.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿的路上看到 Chika 了。

lines.en: : Did you know she's been looking for you?
lines.zh: : 你知道她一直在找你吗？

lines.en: I see that lying won't help either.
lines.zh: 我明白了，撒谎也没用。

lines.en: My eyes focus once more on her arm, worrying about the state of the lacerations concealed beneath the same hand she'd used to make them.
lines.zh: 我的目光重新落在她的手臂上，为那只手下面遮着的伤口状况担忧——正是这只手造成了它们。

lines.en: It's funny, but it isn't- how what destroys can so quickly regret and rebuild.
lines.zh: 很可笑，却又并不可笑——毁灭性的东西竟能如此迅速地懊悔并重建。

lines.en: And it hurts, but it doesn't- bathed in the light of static and watching in awe as what is beautiful breaks before me.
lines.zh: 而它很痛，却又不痛——沐浴在静电的微光里，我敬畏地看着美好的事物在我面前碎裂。

lines.en: scene rinisfine2
: Hey...Rin. What's going on?
lines.zh: : 嘿……Rin。怎么了？

lines.en: : I'm...not really sure if this is just me exaggerating or not, but do you need to go to the hospital? Can you show me your arm?
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定自己是不是在夸大其词，但你需要去医院吗？能让我看看你的手臂吗？

lines.en: How am I supposed to get through to her if she doesn't even know I'm here?...
lines.zh: 如果她甚至不知道我在这里，我到底该怎么打动她？……

lines.en: I move closer and crouch down, expecting that she might look bigger when towering over me.
lines.zh: 我挪近一些蹲下身，以为她居高临下俯视我的时候会显得高大一点。

lines.en: I'm wrong.
lines.zh: 我错了。

lines.en: Her eyes are more swollen than they were the last time I saw her. And while the trace of tears is present in her eyes, none of them fall.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛比我上次见她时肿得更厉害。尽管泪痕还在眼里，却没有一滴落下来。

lines.en: They cling to her eyelids like her fist clings to her wounds, never fully accepting why she is where she is or how she wound up there.
lines.zh: 它们黏在她的眼皮上，就像她的拳头死死按住伤口一样，始终不愿完全接受自己身在何处、又是怎么走到这一步的。

lines.en: But, on the bright side, the air conditioner is turned on full-blast...so at least she’s not drenched in sweat anymore.
lines.zh: 不过往好处想，空调开到了最大……所以至少她不再被汗水浸透了。

lines.en: : Rin, talk to me.
lines.zh: : Rin，跟我说说话。

lines.en: : I came all the way here to see you. It's only polite if you at least say...hi or something.
lines.zh: : 我大老远跑来看你。你至少说声……嗨什么的，才算礼貌吧。

lines.en: : Do you...want to watch a movie? Or...listen to music? I can go get your laptop.
lines.zh: : 你想……看部电影吗？还是……听点音乐？我可以去给你拿笔记本。

lines.en: I’m clearly horrible at this.
lines.zh: 我显然糟糕透了。

lines.en: I have no idea what to do to help her or...if she even needs help in the first place.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道该怎么帮她，或者……她究竟是否需要帮助。

lines.en: And I know that might sound like a horrible thing to say when someone is physically wounded, but...this doesn't look life threatening. She could very well have things under control.
lines.zh: 我知道在某个身上带伤的人面前说这种话听起来很糟糕，可是……这看起来并不致命。她很可能自己控制得住。

lines.en: {b}I just need her to speak and confirm that.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}我只需要她开口确认这一点。{/b}

lines.en: Out of ideas, I reach out and poke her leg, hoping that a physical sensation will be enough to drag her back to reality.
lines.zh: 无计可施之下，我伸手戳了戳她的腿，希望一个物理上的触感足以把她拖回现实。

lines.en: : Rin. Snap out of it. I'm here.
lines.zh: : Rin。振作一点。我在这里。

lines.en: scene rinisfine4
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Wondering why you're just sitting here in the dark with blood dripping down your arm.
lines.zh: : 在想你为什么就这么坐在黑暗里，血顺着胳膊往下滴。

lines.en: : Rin, where is Futaba? You shouldn’t be alone right now.
lines.zh: : Rin，Futaba 在哪儿？你现在不该一个人待着。

lines.en: : Alone?...
lines.zh: : 一个人？……

lines.en: : But...you’re here...
lines.zh: : 可是……你在这儿啊……

lines.en: : I’m not alone at all...
lines.zh: : 我一点都不孤单……

lines.en: I sigh to myself and try and think up some solution, but wind up right where I started- the crossroads between not knowing anything and having seen too much.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，试图想出什么解决办法，结果又绕回了原点——一无所知与见得太多之间的十字路口。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : ...Talk?
: About what?...
lines.zh: : 聊什么？……

lines.en: : Did we have plans to hang out tonight?...
lines.zh: : 我们今晚约好要一起玩吗？……

lines.en: : Sorry, but I don’t feel very good right now...I think we’ll...have to postpone...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可我现在感觉不太好……我想我们……得改天了……

lines.en: : I’m not going anywhere. I’m worried about you.
lines.zh: : 我哪儿都不去。我担心你。

lines.en: : You’re...always worried about me...
lines.zh: : 你……总是担心我……

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : The worst is already over...
lines.zh: : 最糟的部分已经过去了……

lines.en: : Now, I’m just sitting here...
lines.zh: : 现在，我只是坐在这儿……

lines.en: : I know. But I want to sit here with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但我想陪你一起坐在这儿。

lines.en: : Pervert...
lines.zh: : 变态……

lines.en: : I’m not wearing any pants right now...of course you want to sit with me...
lines.zh: : 我现在没穿裤子……你当然想陪我坐着……

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better...I’d think you were here with...ulterior motives...
lines.zh: : 要不是我心里有数……我都要以为你是带着……别的目的来的……

lines.en: : I don't have any {i}ulterior motives.{/i} I just want to help you.
lines.zh: : 我没有任何{i}别的目的{/i}。我只是想帮你。

lines.en: Even I know better than to do something like that in the state she’s in.
lines.zh: 就连我也知道，在她这种状态下不该做那种事。

lines.en: I feel like even saying the wrong thing could cause her to shut down right now.
lines.zh: 我感觉此刻哪怕说错一句话，都可能让她彻底封闭起来。

lines.en: : Everybody always wants to help...how come no one ever does?
lines.zh: : 每个人都想帮忙……可为什么从来没有谁真的帮上忙？

lines.en: : Do you know, Sensei?...Why everything hurts so much?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Sensei？……为什么一切都这么疼？

lines.en: : That's not something anyone knows. It's just the way things are, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 这种事没有谁知道。很遗憾，事情本来就是这样。

lines.en: scene rinisfine5
: Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : The way things are...
lines.zh: : 事情本来就是这样……

lines.en: : You know...you’re a good guy, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你是个好人，Sensei……

lines.en: : Futaba gave me the letter you wrote for me...
lines.zh: : Futaba 把你写给我的信给我了……

lines.en: : It was really nice...Even if it was only three sentences long...
lines.zh: : 写得真好……哪怕只有三句话……

lines.en: : Not nice enough, apparently. I was hoping it might help you snap out of this.
lines.zh: : 显然还不够好。我本来希望它能让你振作起来。

lines.en: : Snap me out of what?
lines.zh: : 让我振作起来，从什么里？

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is who I am.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是我。

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is the real me.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是真正的我。

lines.en: : Some days, I’m happy. Some days, I’m sad.
lines.zh: : 有些日子我开心。有些日子我难过。

lines.en: : The way you’re acting is a lot more than just {i}sad,{/i} Rin...
lines.zh: : 你现在这个样子，可远不止是{i}难过{/i}而已，Rin……

lines.en: : Then I guess it's something else...
lines.zh: : 那我想那大概是别的什么吧……

lines.en: : Maybe I'm just tired?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是累了？

lines.en: : When was the last time you got any sleep?
lines.zh: : 你上一次睡觉是什么时候？

lines.en: scene rinisfine6
: Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : I don't know. Rain check.
lines.zh: : 不知道。改天再答。

lines.en: : Rin, come on. I can't imagine staying up is doing your...mental state any favors?
lines.zh: : Rin，拜托。我无法想象熬夜会对你的……精神状态有任何好处？

lines.en: scene rinisfine5
: My mental state?...
lines.zh: : 我的精神状态？……

lines.en: : Is there something wrong with me, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是有什么毛病，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Think carefully...before you answer...
lines.zh: : 想清楚……再回答……

lines.en: : Fun fact, telling me to think carefully before answering something just makes me not want to answer it.
lines.zh: : 有趣的是，让我「想清楚再回答」，只会让我更不想回答。

lines.en: : Oh no...But the suspense is killing me...
lines.zh: : 哦不……可这悬念快折磨死我了……

lines.en: I place my right hand on Rin's thigh with the desire to wipe away some of the blood, but I hesitate right before I come into contact with it.
lines.zh: 我把右手放到 Rin 的大腿上，想替她擦掉一些血，可就在要碰到它之前，我犹豫了。

lines.en: scene rinisfine6
: Right now?...You really are a pervert, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 现在吗？……你还真是变态啊，Sensei……

lines.en: : That's not what I'm doing, Rin. I'm just trying to...comfort you in one of the only ways I know how.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思，Rin。我只是想……用我仅会的几种方式之一来安慰你。

lines.en: : Oh well...you can {i}comfort{/i} me however you like...
lines.zh: : 哦这样啊……你想怎么{i}安慰{/i}我都行……

lines.en: : Just please leave my underwear on...
lines.zh: : 只要别脱我的内裤就行……

lines.en: : I was planning on it...
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算脱……

lines.en: scene rinisfine7
Rin closes her eyes.
lines.zh: Rin 闭上了眼睛。

lines.en: Frankly, I’m hoping she falls asleep right now because at least that would be {i}one{/i} problem out of the way.
lines.zh: 坦白说，我希望她现在就睡着，因为那样至少能解决掉{i}一个{/i}问题。

lines.en: But no matter how long I stroke her leg for, she sits straight up...never once succumbing to the darkness contained behind her eyelids.
lines.zh: 可不管我抚摸她的腿摸了多久，她都直挺挺地坐着……一次都没有向眼皮后那片黑暗投降。

lines.en: scene rinisfine4
: Hey, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei……

lines.en: : Yes?
: Where do you think we go when we die?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们死后会去哪儿？……

lines.en: : Is now really the best time to be asking that?
lines.zh: : 现在真的是问这个的最好时机吗？

lines.en: : I'm just wondering...you don't have to answer...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道……你不必回答……

lines.en: : It's just that...no one seems to agree on what happens...and I want to know what you think...
lines.zh: : 只是……似乎没有人对死后会怎样达成一致……而我想知道你怎么想……

lines.en: : I don't know, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Rin。

lines.en: : You don't believe in Heaven?
lines.zh: : 你不相信天堂吗？

lines.en: : Heaven? No. But...I guess that going somewhere else after you die is just as plausible as any of the other alternatives.
lines.zh: : 天堂？不信。不过……我觉得死后去某个别的地方，跟其他任何一种可能性一样说得通。

lines.en: : Somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 某个别的地方？

lines.en: : But where?...
lines.zh: : 可是哪儿呢？……

lines.en: : I don’t know. A different place? A different body?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。一个不同的地方？一副不同的身体？

lines.en: : Just...somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 只是……某个别的地方。

lines.en: scene rinisfine5
: A different body?
lines.zh: : 一副不同的身体？

lines.en: : That sounds kind of nice.
lines.zh: : 听起来还挺不错的。

lines.en: : Your body is perfectly fine, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你的身体很好啊，Rin。

lines.en: : You really think so?
lines.zh: : 你真这么觉得？

lines.en: scene rinisfine8
: Well, then what about these? Cause I, for one, don't think I'd mind if they got a little bit bigger.
lines.zh: : 那这两个呢？反正我是不介意它们再大一点。

lines.en: scene rinisfine9
: What's wrong? You've already seen them once before. That should be enough to form an opinion, right?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你之前不是已经看过一次了吗。那总该够你形成意见了吧？

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: scene rinisfine9r
: You know who has really nice boobs, Sensei? {i}Chika.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道谁的胸部特别好看吗，Sensei？{i}Chika。{/i}

lines.en: : Sometimes, when the two of us are in the shower, it takes every ounce of self control I have to not just...reach over and grab them, you know?
lines.zh: : 有时候我们两个一起洗澡，我得用尽全部自制力才能忍住不……伸手过去抓一把，你知道吗？

lines.en: scene rinisfine10
: Are you having a hard time focusing with my tits out, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我把胸露出来，你是不是很难集中注意力，Sensei？

lines.en: : I'll let you touch them if you promise to be gentle...
lines.zh: : 你要是答应温柔点，我可以让你摸……

lines.en: : Rin, now really isn't the time to-
lines.zh: : Rin，现在真的不是时候——

lines.en: : It’s probably hard to control yourself right now, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 你现在大概很难自控吧？

lines.en: : Want to help me see if I can {i}feel?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 想帮我看看我还能不能{i}有感觉吗？……{/i}

lines.en: : Not tonight...And definitely not until we do something about your arm...
lines.zh: : 今晚不行……而且绝对要等你手臂处理完之后……

lines.en: scene rinisfine11
: Oh, come on...it's not even that bad this time...
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托……这次又没那么严重……

lines.en: : This time?
lines.zh: : 这次？

lines.en: : What, you think this is the first time I've ever done something like this?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你以为这种事我是第一次做？

lines.en: : Use your brain, Sensei. You didn't think my doctor's appointment the other day was for a {i}doctor{/i}-doctor, did you?
lines.zh: : 动动脑子，Sensei。你该不会以为我那天去看医生，是看那种「{i}医生{/i}」的医生吧？

lines.en: : Were you worried that I was some kind of tragically ill heroine?...One who you'd inevitably grow closer to before my sickness came to claim me?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在担心我是什么命途多舛的女主角吧？……那种你不可避免地会跟她越走越近、然后疾病就来把我带走的女主角？

lines.en: scene rinisfine12
: Unfortunately for both of us, my {i}sickness{/i} already claimed me a long, long time ago...
lines.zh: : 对我们两个来说都很遗憾，我的{i}病{/i}在很久很久以前就把我带走了……

lines.en: : Now, I'm just a fucked up mess of imbalanced chemicals- held together by thick wristbands, cover-up, and an overly-active sexual imagination.
lines.zh: : 现在，我只是一团由失衡的化学物质堆成的、烂透了的烂摊子——靠厚厚的腕带、遮瑕膏，和过于活跃的性幻想拼凑在一起。

lines.en: : Does Futaba know?
lines.zh: : Futaba 知道吗？

lines.en: : About my overly-active sexual imagination? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 知道我性幻想过于活跃？知道。

lines.en: : About your cutting...
lines.zh: : 你自残的事呢……

lines.en: scene rinisfine13
: Ahh.
: Not this time. But she knows it's happened before.
lines.zh: : 这次不知道。但她知道以前发生过。

lines.en: : Guess that makes three people now...You, Futaba, and the doctor.
lines.zh: : 那现在就是第三个人了……你、Futaba，还有那个医生。

lines.en: : And what did the doctor say? Shouldn't they have done something to, like...prevent this? You just saw them the other day.
lines.zh: : 医生怎么说？他们总该做点什么来……那个……防止这种事吧？你前几天才刚去看过。

lines.en: : The doctor said the same thing anyone else would...To just...not do it anymore.
lines.zh: : 医生说的跟任何别人都会说的一样……就是……别再做了。

lines.en: : Like it's that simple.
lines.zh: : 说得好像就这么简单似的。

lines.en: : That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？

lines.en: Rin shakes her head in place of saying no.
lines.zh: Rin 摇了摇头，代替了说「不」。

lines.en: : She gave me a few medications that are supposed to start helping me feel {i}better,{/i} but...
lines.zh: : 她开了几种药给我，说是应该能让我开始{i}好受{/i}些，可是……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 可是什么？

lines.en: scene rinisfine14
: But I don't like them.
lines.zh: : 可是我不喜欢那些药。

lines.en: : They make me feel all...fake and stuff...
lines.zh: : 它们让我觉得整个人都……很假什么的……

lines.en: : Like it's somebody else's mind inside of mine...
lines.zh: : 就好像我的脑子里住着别人的意识……

lines.en: scene rinisfine12
: Oh. I guess I should probably pull my shirt down, huh?
lines.zh: : 哦。我想我大概该把衣服拉下来了，是吧？

lines.en: : ...Yeah. That would probably be for the best...
lines.zh: : ……是啊。那样大概比较好……

lines.en: scene rinisfine14r
Rin fixes her clothing and breathes a sigh that makes me feel like this is just one of many other times something like this has happened.
lines.zh: Rin 整理好衣服，叹了口气——那声叹息让我觉得，这样的事已经发生过许多次了。

lines.en: It's that sigh that makes what she says next so much harder to believe.
lines.zh: 而正是这声叹息，让她接下来要说的话变得难以置信得多。

lines.en: : Everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : I promise.
lines.zh: : 我保证。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I believe that promise.
lines.zh: : 我不确定自己信不信这个保证。

lines.en: : When have I ever lied to you?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候骗过你？

lines.en: : Well, you’ve lied about being okay probably ten times now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，关于「你没事」这件事，你大概已经骗过我十次了。

lines.en: scene rinisfine14r2
: Shit. You're right.
lines.zh: : 操。你说得对。

lines.en: : Maybe I'm just fucked then?
lines.zh: : 那我大概就是彻底没救了吧？

lines.en: : Rin, come on.
lines.zh: : Rin，拜托。

lines.en: : But really...I’ll try my best to not do stuff like this anymore...
lines.zh: : 不过说真的……我会尽力不再做这种事了……

lines.en: : And those aren't just empty words?
lines.zh: : 而那些不只是空话？

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : {i}Everything I said to you{/i} tonight was empty words.
lines.zh: : {i}我今晚对你说的一切{/i}都是空话。

lines.en: : Why do you think I do this?...Because I like the colors?...
lines.zh: : 你觉得我为什么这么做？……因为我喜欢那些颜色吗？……

lines.en: : I don't-
lines.zh: : 我不是——

lines.en: : I'm trying to bring the feelings back. I'm trying to shock myself back to the good Rin. The fun Rin.
lines.zh: : 我是在试着把感觉找回来。我在试着把自己电击回那个好的 Rin。那个有趣的 Rin。

lines.en: : Because everything {i}this{/i} Rin has to say?...It's all completely empty.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}这个{/i} Rin 所说的一切？……全都是空的。

lines.en: : But I know you care...that still gets through.
lines.zh: : 但我知道你在乎我……这一点还是传进去了。

lines.en: : So I can tell you I will try...
lines.zh: : 所以我可以告诉你，我会努力……

lines.en: : But I never should have made it a promise.
lines.zh: : 但我从一开始就不该把它变成一个承诺。

lines.en: : Thank you for catching me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你接住了我。

lines.en: : If you can't promise me that...can you at least promise me something else?
lines.zh: : 如果你没法向我保证那个……你至少能向我保证另一件事吗？

lines.en: : I guess that depends on what you want...
lines.zh: : 那得看你想要什么……

lines.en: : What I want is for you to come to me first next time. Even if I can't help you, I want to at least try.
lines.zh: : 我想要的是，下次你先来找我。哪怕我帮不上忙，我至少想试一试。

lines.en: : And if you can't come to me, at least go to Futaba.
lines.zh: : 而如果你没法来找我，至少去找 Futaba。

lines.en: scene rinisfine15
: Futaba doesn't like blood.
lines.zh: : Futaba 不喜欢血。

lines.en: : I also wouldn't want to bother her with something like this...not when she has her own stuff going on.
lines.zh: : 我也不想拿这种事去烦她……她自己也有自己的事要忙。

lines.en: : Then come to me.
lines.zh: : 那就来找我。

lines.en: scene rinisfine14r2
: I'll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽力。

lines.en: : Oh, and one more thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有一件事。

lines.en: : You've sure got a lot of demands for someone who's supposed to be comforting me.
lines.zh: : 一个本该在安慰我的人，要求还真多啊。

lines.en: : This last promise is easy. I swear.
lines.zh: : 这最后一个承诺很简单。我发誓。

lines.en: : Just tell me what it is.
lines.zh: : 说吧，是什么。

lines.en: : Sure. Then-
lines.zh: : 好。那就是——

lines.en: : Get some fucking sleep.
lines.zh: : 去他妈的睡一觉。

lines.en: scene rinisfine16
: Heh...heheheh...
lines.zh: : 呵……呵呵呵……

lines.en: : I know you said it would be something easy, but...I wasn't expecting your final demand to be as simple as that...
lines.zh: : 我知道你说会是件简单的事，可……我没想到你最后的要求居然会这么简单……

lines.en: : Is your arm going to be okay? Makoto probably has a first aid kit that I can borrow if-
lines.zh: : 你的手臂没事吗？Makoto 大概有个急救箱，我可以去借——

lines.en: scene rinisfine14r
: That won't be necessary...I normally just let everything close up while I sleep...
lines.zh: : 那倒不必了……我一般都是让伤口在睡觉的时候自己愈合……

lines.en: : Thankfully, I think I should actually be able to now. I always get a little woozy after this kinda thing.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，我觉得这次我大概真能睡着了。这种事之后我总是会有点头晕。
: 所以……

lines.en: : Wait. All that time you've been spending awake, unable to get to sleep-
lines.zh: : 等等。你一直醒着、睡不着的那整段时间——

lines.en: scene rinisfine14r2
: Could have been solved by just doing this earlier. I know.
lines.zh: : 本来只要早点做这个就能解决。我知道。

lines.en: : That's not what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : I know. It's probably hard to tell with my voice being the way it is right now, but I was joking.
lines.zh: : 我知道。大概因为我现在的声音是这样，很难听出来，但我是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : I hold back as long as I can.
lines.zh: : 我尽可能地忍了。

lines.en: : I really do.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: scene rinisfine16r
: It's just {i}really{/i} fucking hard, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 只是{i}真的{/i}他妈很难，Sensei。

lines.en: : I'm sure it is...
lines.zh: : 我知道很难……

lines.en: : Thank you for worrying about me...Really...It means a lot...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你担心我……真的……这对我意义重大……

lines.en: : But...if you don't mind-
lines.zh: : 不过……如果你不介意——

lines.en: : I'll let you go to sleep. Don't worry.
lines.zh: : 我让你去睡吧。别担心。

lines.en: : You don't...have to leave just yet, you know?
lines.zh: : 你……不用这么快就走，知道吗？

lines.en: : You can stick around as long as you want.
lines.zh: : 你想待多久就待多久。

lines.en: : Futaba is sleeping at her friend’s house again tonight, so she won’t be coming home.
lines.zh: : Futaba 今晚又睡在她朋友家，所以她不会回来。

lines.en: : I just...I'm going to pass out...and I think I could sleep a little easier with you by my side.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我要昏过去了……而我觉得有你在身边，我能睡得稍微安稳一点。

lines.en: : That's all you needed to say.
lines.zh: : 你早说这个就行了。

lines.en: : I’ll wait right here until you fall asleep.
lines.zh: : 我就在这儿等着，直到你睡着。

lines.en: scene rinisfine17
: Okay...
: I'm sorry for worrying you. I really am...
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你担心了。真的……

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei……

lines.en: : Of course.
: Goodnight, Rin.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Rin。

lines.en: scene black
Rin falls asleep right away, but I stay in the room for another hour or so just to make sure she doesn’t wake back up.
lines.zh: Rin 立刻就睡着了，但我又在房间里待了大约一个小时，只为确认她不会再醒过来。

lines.en: I use the sleeve of my blazer to dry the blood off of her arm and her thigh.
lines.zh: 我用西装外套的袖子擦干了她手臂和大腿上的血。

lines.en: It feels strangely familiar.
lines.zh: 这感觉莫名地熟悉。

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
$ rindorm20 = True
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I immediately go to sleep when I get home.
lines.zh: 我一到家就立刻睡了。

lines.en: I hope tomorrow is a better day.
lines.zh: 希望明天会是更好的一天。

lines.en: scene black
